newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila power firm unconcerned at fuel price hike.
newsitem.headline: Manila power firm unconcerned at fuel price hike.

text.p: The Philippines' National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Wednesday that the latest fuel price rise would have a minimal effect on electricity rates.
"This will have a minimal impact (on power rates)," Napocor tariff division manager Edgardo Orencia told reporters.
He said Napocor, the country's biggest power generator, has been using mostly hydro and coal-thermal energy to provide power, instead of bunker fuel.
Napocor adjusts its rates every month based on the cost of its raw materials and the prevailing foreign exchange rates.

The Energy Regulatory Board earlier announced that diesel oil will be raised by 50 centavos to 7.57 pesos per litre, while regular gasoline will go up by 4.8 centavos to 9.49 pesos per litre from Thursday.
